title: Yamal on Clásico day v Messi, Ronaldo and Mbappé at the same age
checked: Clásico 25 Oct 2026, Camp Nou: Real Madrid won 2-1; Mbappé 41' (Martín's clearance off him from Diomande's cross) and 87' (Camavinga drew Joan García, squared, tap-in); Raphinha 61'; late in the first half Fermín López sent Yamal clean through and he shot wide from near the corner of the six-yard box; it ended Barça's nine-win start (AP via TSN and La Nación; Africa Soccer). Yamal b. 13 Jul 2007 = 19y 104d. By 19th birthday, all competitions, club and country: Yamal 182 games 56+64, Mbappé 90 games 39+29, Messi 43 games 11+6, Ronaldo 55 games 6+7 (Planet Football's two tables; one outlet, so said as 'by nineteen' only). After 100 games: Messi 40+19 at 20y 105d, Yamal 21+30 at 17y 7m, Ronaldo 17+25 at 19y 262d (90min + Bolavip agree). Trophies by Clásico day: World Cup 2026 (Spain 1-0 Argentina aet, ESPN + Wikipedia), Euro 2024, La Liga 2024-25 and 2025-26 (Wikipedia). Kits in the gameplay: Barcelona drawn in one shirt colour (the game's sprite has no stripes).

lines.text: Clásico day. Lamine Yamal, nineteen years and 104 days old, against Kylian Mbappé.
lines.say: Klasseeko day. Lahmeen Yahmal, nineteen years and a hundred and four days old, against Keelian Embapay.

lines.text: Late in the first half, Fermín López sent him clean through. Wide.
lines.say: Late in the first half, Fermeen Lopez sent him clean through. Wide.

lines.text: Mbappé scored twice, the winner three minutes from time. Real Madrid won two-one at Camp Nou.
lines.say: Embapay scored twice, the winner three minutes from time. Real Madrid won two-one at Camp Noo.

lines.text: It ended Barcelona's perfect start. Nine league wins in a row, gone.

scene.headline: Mbappé ends Barça's perfect start
scene.standfirst: Real Madrid win 2-1 at Camp Nou after Yamal misses a clear chance. Barcelona's run of nine straight league wins is over.

lines.text: But one bad night says very little. So how does Yamal compare with Messi, Ronaldo and Mbappé at the same age?
lines.say: But one bad night says very little. So how does Yahmal compare with Messy, Ronaldo and Embapay at the same age?

lines.text: By his nineteenth birthday: fifty-six goals and sixty-four assists, for club and country.
The legends by nineteen, goals plus assists: Mbappé sixty-eight. Messi seventeen. Ronaldo thirteen.
lines.say: The legends by nineteen, goals plus assists: Embapay sixty-eight. Messy seventeen. Ronaldo thirteen.

scene.title: Goals + assists
scene.note: All competitions, club and country · Planet Football

lines.text: Yamal had more than all three of them put together.
lines.say: Yahmal had more than all three of them put together.

scene.sub: Yamal v Mbappé, Messi and Ronaldo combined

lines.text: The catch? He'd played 182 games. Messi only forty-three.
lines.say: The catch? He'd played a hundred and eighty-two games. Messy only forty-three.

lines.text: So match the games. After a hundred each, Messi had fifty-nine goals and assists. Yamal fifty-one. Ronaldo forty-two.
lines.say: So match the games. After a hundred each, Messy had fifty-nine goals and assists. Yahmal fifty-one. Ronaldo forty-two.

lines.text: The difference is age. Yamal reached a hundred games at seventeen. Messi was twenty.
lines.say: The difference is age. Yahmal reached a hundred games at seventeen. Messy was twenty.

lines.text: And he's already won the World Cup, the Euros and two league titles.
So who wins the age-match? Yamal, or Mbappé?
lines.say: So who wins the age-match? Yahmal, or Embapay?

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
